name: Model Capability Registry
description: A registry of model capabilities that captures what each model supports: context window size (total and output), modalities (text, image, audio, video, code), tool calling, structured output, function calling, streaming, parallel tool calls, system prompt support, and maximum temperature range. The registry maps model IDs to capability sets.
purpose: Provide a single source of truth for model capabilities so the routing and adaptation layers can make informed decisions about which model to use and how to format requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Registry is a typed key-value store mapping model IDs to Capability records

Capability record includes: contextWindow, outputWindow, modalities[], supportsToolCalling, supportsStructuredOutput, supportsFunctionCalling, supportsStreaming, supportsParallelToolCalls, supportsSystemPrompt, temperatureRange
Registry can be populated from static data and from runtime discovery
Queries support: get a model, list models by capability, find best match for capability requirements
Registry is extensible with custom capability fields via metadata map
All popular models pre-seeded (GPT-4o, GPT-4, Claude 3 Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, Gemini Pro/Ultra, Mistral Large, Llama 3 70B/405B)
